card.name: Words before canon or scripture terms
card.fires_on: Small words like 'the', 'five' or 'other' just before a scripture or literary-canon term, in passages about Jewish texts or literary tradition. Seen in Bible, Torah and Ecclesiastes passages and in African-American literary theory.

modes.label: Before Jewish scripture terms
modes.description: A small word such as 'the' or 'five' right before a name of biblical books or scrolls.
modes.example: Ecclesiastes (Hebrew: Scroll of Qohelet) is one of the<< five>> scrolls (Megillot).

modes.label: Before literary tradition terms
modes.description: A word before 'tradition' or 'tropes' in literary criticism.
modes.example: allow the<< black>> tradition to speak for itself about its nature

card.writes: It pushes toward words like 'canon' and 'scheme', which fits an upcoming term for a body of texts.
card.plain: It fires on little words just before a phrase about a set of sacred or literary texts, such as the Bible or the scrolls.
